services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: The New Orleans Pharmacy Museum offers private guided tours for groups ranging from 10 to 50 people. A private guided tour of the Pharmacy Museum offers guests exclusive access to the museum for two hours and includes a one-hour, fully narrated guided tour of the museum’s first floor of exhibits. For the final hour, guests are welcome to explore the Pharmacy Museum’s second floor of exhibits, enjoy the private historic courtyard, and speak with the docent. Guests are also given the opportunity to consult with a docent ahead of their scheduled tour in order to make any specific requests regarding topics discussed or exhibits covered.
